confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a search that surfaced the RBA exchange-rates page. The food and drink anchors rely mainly on Numbeo-derived figures (via Expatica, June 2026) and a few travel guides. I converted euros to USD at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR, which is an assumed rate and not a searched one. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal are fairly well supported. Cocktail and wine are less certain: I based them on guide ranges (cocktail about €10-12, a glass of wine from about €5-6) and their usual relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season rate. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings, so these are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Estimated directly for Rome using Numbeo-style averages. Accommodation reflects a major Southern European tourist capital in peak summer, comparable to Barcelona or Athens in high season.
